scope: Separate2D periodic SC slab with original HREF-MIX transferred coefficients, one equipotential patch and grounded bottom. No change to actual D50mm four-pad phantom, no empirical material/contact correction, no new actual four-pad CEM solve.

input_provenance.coefficient_operation: Exact copy of already evaluated2000Hz SC gamma and zA. No refit, Rs subtraction, area scaling or transfer of four-pad/50ohm topology.
input_provenance.uncertainty: HREF-MIX declared surrogate SC and uncertain PBS-derived interface impedance; not direct human thoracoabdominal or validated skin-contact measurements.

kernel.definitions: s=x-y, k_n=2*pi*n/L, a=4*pi*t/L, G_ij=integral_i integral_j gamma*K(x-y) dy dx; G is real geometric and has units m^2.
kernel.derivation: Use tanh(2*pi*n*t/L)=1-2/(exp(a*n)+1) and sum cos(2*pi*n*s/L)/n=-log(2*abs(sin(pi*s/L))). The constant mode remains t/L.
kernel.stable_correction_weight: w_n=exp(-a*n)/(n*(1+exp(-a*n))); do not form overflowing exp(a*n).
kernel.entry_tail_bound: abs(delta G_ij) <= l_i*l_j*R_N; abs(delta A_ij) <= l_i*l_j*R_N/abs(gamma). This is a kernel/entry bound, not a solved-current or field error bound; conditioning must be reported.
kernel.no_Fourier_huge_H: The singular infinite-harmonic logarithmic part is integrated directly; only the exponentially decaying finite-thickness correction is truncated.

panel_integration.periodic_shift: For each panel pair choose nearest-center integer m=round((c_i-c_j)/L) and shift the second interval by m*L. Use the same shifted endpoints in every log/smooth term. Reverse pair uses the opposite shift; periodic full-contact seam pairs at +/-L are near pairs.
panel_integration.panel_width_restriction: Require max(panel width)<=L/4. This prevents another periodic singular image inside the shifted rectangle. If future meshes violate it, split rectangles at periodic images rather than applying this formula unchanged.
panel_integration.near_classification: Self, touching, or interval gap <=2*max(l_i,l_j) after periodic shift. Criterion is fixed before execution.
panel_integration.singular_split: log(2*abs(sin(pi*s/L)))=log(abs(s/L))+log(2*pi*sinc(s/L)); the shifted rectangle has abs(s)<L, so the second term is smooth and sinc is positive.
panel_integration.near_smooth: Integrate -log(2*pi*sinc(s/L))/pi by tensor Gauss-Legendre at the declared order, multiplied by physical panel Jacobians. Add constant and exact correction once.
panel_integration.far_regular: Integrate the full periodic logarithmic part -log(2*abs(sin(pi*s/L)))/pi directly by regular tensor Gauss; do not evaluate four nearly cancelling F terms. Add the same analytic constant and exact correction once. Do not double-count a Gaussian correction.
panel_integration.roundoff_plan: For near singular F-corner sums use a stable local-scale form plus compensated sum. When cancellation can affect the declared tolerance, reevaluate the identical analytic expression with Decimal50-digit arithmetic; record fallback count and compare50/70-digit values in a small scalar contract. Precision fallback changes arithmetic only, never kernel, material or fitted data.
panel_integration.periodic_constant_contract: On full-period contact, sum_j G_ij must agree with t*l_i before adding contact impedance. Test the seam explicitly; never repair row sums or renormalize G.

graded_mesh.Robin_length: ell_R=abs(gamma*zA), diagnostic dimensional material/contact length in metres; no empirical correction or added layer.

recommended_nested_family.refinement: Build one symmetric geometric base mesh and bisect every panel once/twice. This yields genuinely nested edge refinement with minimum ell_R/8 and ell_R/16 at256/512.
recommended_nested_family.reason: Keeping the minimum ell_R/4 fixed at every panel count leaves the first edge average unresolved by the panel-count axis; nested refinement also preserves old trial spaces.

graded_mesh.base_construction: On each half contact with M=64 panels, widths w_j=w_min*r^j, j=0..M-1, edge to centre. Solve w_min*sum(r^j)=half_width using a bounded scalar bisection in log(r) with expm1-stable sums. Mirror exactly about zero and retain physical endpoints. Record actual widths and terminal floating closure error; no global physical-area rescaling.
graded_mesh.geometry_checks: Positive widths, exact contact endpoints/centre, mirror symmetry, actual minimum/maximum widths, max width<=L/4 and length sum within predeclared floating tolerance.
graded_mesh.peak_hold: Save every native panel q_RMS max with its edge distance and width. Weighted J95 or integral convergence never establishes continuum edge Jmax.

linear_system_and_energy.basis_normalization: D=diag(sqrt(l_i)); solve (D^-1*A*D^-1)*u=V*sqrt(l_i), q=D^-1*u. Exact trial/test coordinate scaling preserves complex symmetry and physics; it is not regularization.
linear_system_and_energy.current: I=sum_i l_i*q_i, units A/m of out-of-plane length.
linear_system_and_energy.bulk_energy_indicator: Integral_slab peak|E|^2 = (q^H*G*q)/abs(gamma)^2, conditional on the quadrature operator; RMS_L2=sqrt(real(q^H*G*q)/(2*L*t*abs(gamma)^2)). This is not independent E-field validation.
linear_system_and_energy.structural_gates: Real G, complex-symmetric A, small algebraic residual, passive real powers, signed complex power closure. Report normalization/condition estimate. Reject material negative/passivity failures; no clipping of eigenvalues or fitted repair.
linear_system_and_energy.no_finite_field_export_claim: The first kernel batch exports contact solution/operator diagnostics, not a newly independently reconstructed spatial E field.

finite_batch.old_spatial_vector_E_L2_gate: N/A for this kernel-only batch; do not label the old2% spatial field gate passed or silently replace it with the operator energy indicator.
finite_batch.nonaborting: All delta flags/Jmax increases are exported. Passing them permits only a numerical next-step review, not continuum/human/contact safety adoption.

verification.full_period_equipotential: q=V/(zA+t/gamma), I=L*q and signed complex source/contact/bulk power. Check all panel values, current, kernel row sum and wrap seam without rescaling.
verification.manufactured_flux: Full-period q_exact(x)=q0+qc*cos(k_m*x)+qs*sin(k_m*x), complex coefficients; no physical contact edge in this verification problem.
verification.manufactured_forcing: U(x)=(zA+t/gamma)*q0 + (zA+T_m)*(qc*cos(k_m*x)+qs*sin(k_m*x)); T_m=tanh(k_m*t)/(gamma*k_m). U is NON-equipotential and used ONLY for MMS tests, never as the partial equipotential candidate.
verification.manufactured_metrics: Compare solved panel q against exact panel averages and against the continuous q in a true length-weighted L2 norm. Report projection variance separately. Integral |q_exact|^2 and cross terms can be evaluated from the three exact Fourier coefficients, rather than reusing kernel quadrature.
verification.manufactured_energy: Compare conditional Galerkin bulk power with the independent closed-form Fourier power for the prescribed exact flux; discretization error is expected and must be reported, not forced to machine zero.
verification.suggested_first_MMS: Modes1 and4 across128/256/512 full-period graded panels at Gauss32, plus one full-period constant check. This is six MMS RHS plus one analytic-contract RHS; five partial-contact RHS remain separate. Root must explicitly admit the final finite list/time budget before execution.
verification.not_MMS_claims: A constant-mode contract or algebraic power balance alone does not validate the partial-contact solution or prove edge-current convergence.

resources_and_artifacts.memory_plan: Real G plus one complex scaled solve matrix and blocked pair quadrature only; never allocate P*P*q*q or a huge Fourier matrix. No preceding field/Q cache decoding.
resources_and_artifacts.finite_owner: One root owner/numerical child, actual PID/startticks and global locks, pre-import CPU/BLAS configuration, parent memory/watchdog and finite child deadline. Runtime feasibility must be measured; no600s fit promise.
resources_and_artifacts.save_policy: Exclusive per-case arrays/normalized metadata, source/input/geometry SHA, immediate resume index, no overwritten partials or repeated completed solve. Normalize/encode all JSON before opening.
resources_and_artifacts.admission: No numerical execution by preparer. Root requires independent source/math review and actual preceding-result review/publication before launch.

open_review_items: Confirm stable near-corner evaluation/fallback criterion at the actual extreme grading ratio.
Confirm nearest-image interval restriction covers every full-period seam pair.
Choose explicit first MMS and partial-contact total RHS count under the finite owner budget.
Do not infer independent field convergence from q^H*G*q energy closure.
